slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly confident

open mic nights

go to one improv or open mic night a month, even just to watch at first. being around people who are comfortable failing in public is contagious, and one day you'll get up too.

dumb questions

in every meeting or class this week, ask one question you think is dumb. half the room was wondering the same thing, and you're the only one who didn't pretend to understand.

one kept promise

make one small promise to yourself every morning, like 10 pushups or 1 page, and never break it. self trust is built by keeping tiny promises, not by making big ones.

knowledge snacks

instead of scrolling in the morning, spend 5 minutes learning about art, science or history. a sharper mind makes you calmer in every conversation, you stop fearing you'll have nothing to say.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowledge snacks

instead of scrolling in the morning, spend 5 minutes learning about art, science or history. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and you'll stop fearing you have nothing to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
taking compliments

for a month, answer every compliment with only "thank you", no "oh it's nothing". pushing compliments away trains your brain to believe them a little less every time.
